notes: North-up sheet. Printed names: PARK AV., FRANCIS LANE, CYPRESS, WINDSOR, CALVIN, KEMPER LANE; 'Street' added to the suffixless Cypress, Windsor and Calvin as on sheets 325-327. Kemper Lane's N-S leg runs along the left edge with only its east line (x~343) on the paper; centre taken as east line - 30 ft (60' printed), +/-20 px, so the Windsor/Kemper T and the lower Kemper bend carry that uncertainty. Francis Lane leaves Park's east side (NE edge is the chamfer from (3255,555)); Cypress ends at Francis's NE edge, matching sheet 325. Francis turns due south at the Edgecliff junction: only Francis's west line (x~6195) is drawn on the south leg, so the Edgecliff and Calvin points use west line + 30 ft; Edgecliff barely enters at the right edge (north line y~5620, pipe y~5785). Park Avenue and Kemper Lane both run off the bottom edge; by sheet 330 their junction is just below this sheet (~y 7880-7950), so it is not recorded here. A dashed outline labelled BRIDGE runs from the foot of Park Avenue (~(3080,6520)) diagonally down-left across Kemper to ~(2450,7550); not a street pick. An unnamed Eden Park drive leaves the lower Kemper bend running south (one curved edge (360,6370)-(760,7280) and a 4 in. pipe), other edge off the paper; not recorded. 'See Volume Two' strip on the left edge.
